config:
# Benchmark corpus config — written to <corpus>/.cogz/config.toml by
# fetch_corpus.py. httpx is replaced with the corpus name.
# Mirrors the values used across the report-card campaign; changing
# anything here invalidates cross-corpus comparisons.

[project]
name = "httpx"

[storage]
db_path = ".cogz/cogz.db"

[embedding]
code_model = "nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed-int8"
knowledge_model = "BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5"
dimension = 768
nli_model = "cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-xsmall"
auto_download = true
model_idle_ttl = 300
model_min_free_mb = 512

[search]
fts_weight = 0.3
vec_weight = 0.4
code_vec_weight = 0.3
rrf_k = 60
max_results = 20
min_source_proportion = 0.2
source_balance_enabled = false
merge_strategy = "detect"
min_relevance = 0.05
edge_weighted_expansion = true
silence_threshold = 0.05
top_diversity_share = 0.2
provenance_boost = 0.3
drift_penalty = 0.7
fts_title_weight = 5.0
mmr_lambda = 0.7
graph_first_enabled = true
graph_max_seeds = 20
graph_max_hops = 2
graph_hop_decay = 0.5
graph_weight = 0.35
silence_strength_floor = 0.64
prf_enabled = true
prf_feedback_docs = 5
prf_max_terms = 8
graph_seed_min_sim = 0.7

[search.calibration.code]
mid = 0.32
width = 0.04

[search.calibration.knowledge]
mid = 0.64
width = 0.03

[consolidation]
dedup_threshold = 0.85
title_match_threshold = 0.85
contradiction_check = true
promotion_threshold = 3
contradiction_threshold = 0.7
contradiction_cosine_threshold = 0.85
contradiction_length_ratio = 5.0
dedup_nli_threshold = 0.85

[index]
allow = []
deny = []

[retention]
observation_prune_after_days = 90
tombstone_max_count = 1000

[context]
default_token_budget = 4096
task_token_budget = 8192
escalation_token_budget = 8192
cold_start_rules = 5
task_max_results = 40
task_max_hops = 2
escalation_max_results = 20
escalation_max_hops = 3
tiered_push = true
tier0_rules = 3
